note: Active display areas, origin at the top-left of the left screen's active area. Gaps (40 mm) and the bar's vertical position (centred) are assumptions: measure the real wall and update.

screens.output_hint: HDMI, custom mode 1920x360@60 if the EDID is wrong
USB-C (DisplayPort alt mode), rotated to portrait

viewing.note: Text sizes follow from the viewing distance (decided 2026-10-21: 3 m, the far end of the sofa). Cap heights: floor 3.67 mm per metre (11 mm at 3 m) for the smallest text (labels, times), text 6 mm per metre (18 mm) for names and rows. Nothing is smaller than the floor; tools/legibility.py checks it.

tv.note: The Samsung TV app (docs/TV_APP.md): a 77-inch 16:9 TV watched from 4 m (the user, 2026-10-31). Its page is 1920x1080 CSS pixels whatever the panel; text sizes use the wall's viewing rule at this distance.
